description: This file contains shell functions and scripts used for platform-specific upgrade procedures and integrity checks for a device, including verifying partition sizes, performing firmware upgrades, and checking compatibility based on board name.

methods.name: gemini_check_redboot_parts
methods.description: Checks and verifies the sizes and names of specific MTD partitions for the device.

methods.name: gemini_do_platform_upgrade
methods.description: Extracts firmware parts from an archive and writes them to appropriate partitions for upgrading.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the current device is supported for sysupgrade based on board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific firmware upgrade process based on board type.
